title: Use and Deployment of Israeli Company QuaDream's Spyware or Other Technologies in Singapore
what_it_is: Use and Deployment of Israeli Company QuaDream's Spyware or Other Technologies in Singapore

sections.label: Government spyware use questions
sections.summary: MPs ask whether the Government uses QuaDream spyware and other spyware technologies, and whether judicial oversight or warrants are required.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) whether the Government is a user of Israeli company QuaDream’s spyware; and (b) whether the Government deploys this or other spyware technologies in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have to deal with serious national security threats to Singapore, ranging from terrorism to foreign subversion, espionage and interference.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To this end, agencies charged with the mission of safeguarding national security necessarily have to rely on a range of intelligence capabilities, including harnessing technology.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For obvious reasons, the Government cannot and should not discuss specifics on any operational aspects or capabilities regarding our national security.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If such technology is deployed – and this is just an assumption – is it subject to any kind of judicial oversight?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Does a warrant need to be obtained, for example, before such technologies are deployed?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: They also said that it is likely to be so because of who I am individually or what I do.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: So, based on what the Minister of State said just now that reliance on technologies is required for national security reasons, can I get his confirmation that I should have absolutely no concerns that the Singapore Government agencies are trying to hack into my phone?

sections.label: Police report suggestion
sections.summary: The Minister suggests Ms Sylvia Lim make a Police report if she has concerns about her iPhone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: If Ms Sylvia Lim has any concerns with regard to what has happened to her iPhone, I suggest she make a Police report.
